fields.record_title: Exact title of the page or document
fields.reference_date: Date or period the record describes (ISO date, or text when the source gives no precise date)
fields.retrieved: Date JanDrishti last fetched and read the record
fields.geography: Area the record covers — never widen it in the UI
fields.availability: live | unavailable (with note) — whether the URL still served the record on the retrieval date
fields.caveats: Limits on how the record may be used

sources.record_title: Assembly Constituency-wise Elector data — Elector as on last date of nomination (GE to WBLA 2026)
sources.verification: All 294 rows parsed; every row satisfies male + female + third gender = total; Phase 1 (36,077,171), Phase 2 (32,173,837) and State (68,251,008) totals reconcile with the printed totals.
sources.caveats: Electors on the roll at the last date of nomination — not the final roll after poll-day additions, not votes cast and not Census population. The District column uses CEO electoral districts (e.g. Kolkata North / Kolkata South).

sources.publisher: Election Commission of India schedule, as reproduced by Hindustan Times
sources.record_title: West Bengal Assembly Election List (phase-wise AC numbers and names)
sources.verification: All 294 names cross-checked against the CEO elector table; only spelling variants differ (e.g. Manikchak / Manickchak, Bardhaman / Burdwan). SC/ST counts (68 / 16) match the delimitation.
sources.caveats: The PDF's text layer is out of order (names do not sit beside their numbers), so it must not be re-parsed naively. Replace with CEO/ECI master data in a production import.

sources.record_title: General Election to Assembly Constituencies: Trends & Results May-2026 — Uttarpara (S25 / AC 185)
sources.availability: unavailable — returns HTTP 404 since the results site moved to the October 2026 bye-elections (results.eci.gov.in now redirects to ResultAcByeOct2026)
sources.verification: Page could not be re-read. Search-engine index of the page shows the winner with 80,612 votes; the result is corroborated by eci-statistical-wiki, etv-result and bt-result.
sources.caveats: ECI states trends/results data is entered by Returning Officers; the final record is Form 20 and the Statistical Report.

sources.publisher: Wikipedia (citing ECI 'West Bengal General Legislative Election 2026 Statistical Report')
sources.record_title: Uttarpara Assembly constituency — Election results 2026 and 2021; composition
sources.verification: Arithmetic checked: 80,612 − 70,197 = 10,415; 80,612 / 205,454 = 39.24%. Candidate rows listed sum to 204,115, short of the 205,454 turnout, so minor candidates are missing from the table.
sources.refresh_cadence: Replace with ECI Form 20 / Statistical Report
sources.caveats: Secondary transcription. Infobox electors (216,312) disagree with the CEO table (228,272) and with the turnout-implied electorate (~228,590).

sources.record_title: Assembly Election 2026: BJP's Dipanjan Chakraborty wins Uttarpara by 10,415 votes
sources.verification: Winner and margin match ECI-derived figures.
sources.caveats: News report; corroboration only.

sources.record_title: Uttarpara Election Results 2026: BJP's Dipanjan Chakraborty defeats AITC's Sirsanya Bandopadhyay by 10415 votes
sources.verification: Headline winner, runner-up party (AITC) and margin match. Interim live-blog counts on the page are running tallies — do not reuse them.
sources.caveats: News live blog; corroboration only.

sources.publisher: Delimitation Commission of India (via Wikipedia citation)
sources.record_title: Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 2008 — West Bengal, No. 185 Uttarpara
sources.verification: Composition (Uttarpara Kotrung M, Konnagar M, and Nabagram, Kanaipur and Raghunathpur GPs of Sreerampur Uttarpara CD block; part of No. 27 Sreerampur PC) agrees with the prototype's research.
sources.caveats: Read through a secondary citation. Fetch the Delimitation Order PDF and CEO AC map before drawing any boundary.

sources.record_title: Population — Wardwise Population & Male & Female Census'2011
sources.verification: All 24 ward rows re-read from the PDF; they sum to 159,413 (81,457 male, 77,956 female), matching the PDF's stated totals.
sources.caveats: Census 2011 and municipality only — not current, and not constituency-wide.

sources.record_title: Konnagar (Municipality), Hugli — Census 2011
sources.verification: 76,172 (38,653 male, 37,519 female) agrees across secondary sources; Wikipedia's municipality article shows 76,152 (likely a transcription slip).
sources.caveats: Secondary compilation. Confirm against the Census 2011 Primary Census Abstract (Hooghly) or Konnagar Municipality.

sources.record_title: Serampur Uttarpara Block, Hugli — towns and villages, Census 2011
sources.geography: Census towns of Sreerampur Uttarpara CD block
sources.verification: Kanaipur CT 26,814; Nabagram Colony CT 18,358; Raghunathpur (PS-Dankuni) CT 9,650 — consistent with Wikipedia articles citing Census 2011.
sources.refresh_cadence: Replace with Census 2011 PCA / village directory
sources.caveats: A census town is not the same area as the gram panchayat of the same name. Do not sum these into a constituency population.

sources.record_title: Home page — helplines, hospital contacts, notices
sources.reference_date: Dynamic page (notices up to Oct 2026 seen)
sources.verification: Hospital, fire, police, ambulance and municipal office numbers re-read on 2026-11-01 and match the prototype. A 'Blood Storage Unit at Mahamaya' notice is also present.
sources.caveats: Published contacts only; not confirmed by calling.

sources.record_title: Projects — NUHM, NULM, BSUP/JNNURM, PMAY, Mid-Day Meal
sources.reference_date: Undated; mentions financial years 2015-16 to 2021-22 and MDM start in 2005
sources.verification: Re-read: the page names three UPHCs — UPHC I at Mahamaya Sishu O Matri Mangal Kendra (Sakher Bazar, GT Road, Bhadrakali), UPHC II HAU-1 Makhla near Debeshwari Girls' High School, UPHC III HAU-2 near Karai Factory.
sources.caveats: Programme descriptions, largely legacy. They do not establish current funding, staffing, completion or service levels.

sources.publisher: Uttarpara-Kotrung Municipality (page reproduces a newspaper article)
sources.record_title: Solid Waste Management
sources.reference_date: Undated; describes JICA funding 'scheduled to end in 2017'
sources.verification: Re-read: the 12–14 t/day collection and 3–4 t/day manure figures sit inside a reproduced press article ('the website wrote', quoted rag-pickers, 'Population: 1.75 lakh', Rs 170-crore JICA project) — not a municipal performance report.
sources.refresh_cadence: Replace with current SWM MIS / SBM-U reporting
sources.caveats: Historical, undated press context. Never show as a current KPI.

sources.publisher: Kolkata Metropolitan Development Authority — SE Circle-II, R&B Sector
sources.record_title: e-NIT No. 55/SE/C-II/R&B/KMDA/W-28 (Part-VIII) of 2025-2026 (2nd Call)
sources.verification: Three lots read with Annexure-I road lists, all explicitly 'under Uttarpara Kotrung Municipality'. Each estimated value pairs with a 2% earnest money figure (e.g. ₹94,87,079 → ₹1,89,742), which confirms the value-to-lot pairing.
sources.caveats: A tender invitation — not evidence of award, expenditure, execution or completion. '2nd Call' means the first call did not conclude.

sources.publisher: Kolkata Metropolitan Development Authority — SE Circle-II, R&B Sector
sources.record_title: e-NIT No. 27/SE/C-II/R&B/KMDA/W-28 (Part-VIII) of 2025-2026
sources.verification: Lot headings 3–14 read 'within Uttarpara Kotrung Municipality' (wards 5, 7, 13, 14, 16–23), but Annexure-I lists every one of those works under RISHRA MUNICIPALITY (serial nos. 988–1020), e.g. 'Development of Anjuman Road at ward no.-5 under Rishra Municipality'.
sources.caveats: Internal contradiction. Rishra is outside AC 185. Not shown as an Uttarpara project lead until KMDA confirms which ULB the works belong to.
